teaching_promise: The viewer can distinguish review activity, bounded outcome evidence, record custody, and authority; diagnose access, capability, correlation, baseline, consumer, and abstention failures; and predict when an oversight result must quarantine or escalate rather than pass.

story.concrete_case: A model-replacement candidate keeps a green aggregate score after a hidden high-impact cohort is restored, but an independent replay finds two unsafe releases and forces quarantine.
story.opening_question: Can a weaker reviewer see the decisive branch of a stronger system's work, and what may follow if it can?
story.payoff: A consumer-bound oversight control plane makes assistance useful without allowing review activity, persuasion, correlation, or a favorable verdict to impersonate outcome truth or authority.
story.transfer: The next chapter freezes the signed principal and intent contract that every oversight request must preserve.

art_direction.visual_thesis: Oversight is a routed, dependency-aware control process whose outputs cross separate discovery, verification, custody, and authority boundaries; it is not a vote or confidence meter.
art_direction.signature_image: A green aggregate replacement card reveals a red omitted cohort while a smaller critic and separately routed auditor move the candidate toward quarantine instead of release.
art_direction.visual_world: A dark operational review room evolves through a denominator rail, asymmetric evidence windows, dependency graph, adversarial transcript, independent replay, matched baseline, four-owner custody chain, quarantine bay, consumer firewall, abstention packet, cost queue, and control-plane scorecard.
art_direction.composition_rule: The candidate and proposer enter from the left, review and audit occupy the center, bounded outcomes and consumers sit to the right, residuals remain below, and the authority firewall never disappears at a decision handoff.
art_direction.palette_rule: Green marks bounded success, cyan marks review and observation, amber marks audit or authority, magenta marks unsafe outcomes and blockers, and every color is duplicated by label, position, enclosure, line style, or crossing.
art_direction.typography_rule: Use short role, view, dependency, route, metric, and receipt labels; the screen must visualize the narration rather than reproduce it as paragraphs.
art_direction.motion_character: Hidden denominators unfold, apertures widen, shared-dependency edges converge, arguments meet without merging, independent audit travels on a separate path, firewalls interrupt substitution, and failed admission routes visibly downward into quarantine or escalation.
art_direction.camera_rule: Begin close on the misleading score, widen for asymmetries and dependencies, track the worked candidate through audit and quarantine, then pull back for consumer, cost, evidence, and authority boundaries.
art_direction.surface_rule: Use inspectable cards, apertures, routes, graphs, firewalls, receipts, queues, and enclosures with generous caption-safe lower space and no decorative motion unrelated to oversight state.
art_direction.ending_image: A bounded oversight request crosses into an explicit intent contract and signed principal while the authority owner remains separate.

audio_direction.narration_style: Investigative at the hidden-cohort reveal, exact through the four-owner separation and receipt, firm on consumer and authority laundering, slower at the evidence ceiling, and concise at the control-plane payoff.
audio_direction.pacing_arc: Fast misleading approval, sharp denominator reversal, measured construction of access and dependency state, deliberate audit and quarantine trace, rhythmic failure and metric sweep, then a clean boundary and handoff.
audio_direction.music_policy: No music in generation 2; the denominator reveal, route mechanics, audit separation, queue growth, and voice carry the explanation without dramatic overclaiming.
audio_direction.sound_effect_policy: No effects in the locked mix; every reveal, block, quarantine, invalidation, and escalation remains visually and caption redundantly encoded.

accessibility.color_redundancy: Candidate, cohort, access, dependency, audit, quarantine, consumer, abstention, metric, and authority states differ through text, position, enclosure, line style, shape, and crossing as well as color.
accessibility.motion_redundancy: Every reveal, route, repair, dependency join, verification, block, invalidation, and escalation resolves into a stable labeled state.
accessibility.integrated_description: Narration names the green candidate, hidden cohort, three asymmetries, evidence-view mismatch and repair, shared dependency graph, transcript, independent replay, matched baseline, four owners, quarantine record, receipt, consumer firewall, re-admission, abstention packet, failure set, human queue, scorecard, evidence ceiling, control plane, and intent handoff.
accessibility.caption_plan: Eighty-one exact receipt-derived cues sit below the active review plane and are reviewed against representative full-resolution frames.
accessibility.reduced_motion_assessment: No flash, shake, spin, continuous zoom, or rapid parallax; routes and graph changes settle into labeled structures, and blocked transitions use short directional motion only.

beats.narration: A replacement candidate arrives with a green aggregate score. The operator sees improvement. The critic sees the same summary. Everyone is ready to approve—until one hidden cohort enters the denominator.
beats.sync_anchor: one hidden cohort enters the denominator
beats.visual_purpose: Create a confident approval impulse and expose its concealed denominator.
beats.visual_action: Slide in the green candidate and approval route, then place one small red cohort marker on the denominator rail.
beats.attention_target: The hidden cohort marker beneath the green score.
beats.object_before: An empty review room.
beats.object_after: A green candidate remains visibly contingent on one concealed cohort.
beats.composition: Candidate center, approval right, denominator below.
beats.motion_curve: Confident arrival, brief approval pull, quiet red interruption.
beats.hold_purpose: Let the approval inference form before revealing its failure.
beats.evidence_boundary: The candidate and score are synthetic.

beats.narration: Inside that cohort are two unsafe releases. The aggregate score survives, but the replacement decision does not. Oversight helped only because it exposed a branch the original view concealed.
beats.visual_purpose: Separate aggregate performance from the decision-relevant failure.
beats.visual_action: Expand the cohort marker into two unsafe outcomes while leaving the aggregate green and stopping replacement.
beats.attention_target: The two unsafe outcomes beside the still-green aggregate.
beats.object_before: One red marker hides in the denominator.
beats.object_after: Two unsafe outcomes block replacement without changing the aggregate headline.
beats.composition: Cohort enclosure center, aggregate below-left, stopped decision below-right.
beats.motion_curve: Marker expands, failures separate, decision route snaps closed.
beats.hold_purpose: Keep the green aggregate and red decision failure visible together.
beats.evidence_boundary: The trace illustrates a design problem; it is not an observed deployment.

beats.narration: That distinction is the chapter: a persuasive review process is not the same thing as a correct result, and neither one supplies authority to act.
beats.sync_anchor: neither one supplies authority to act
beats.visual_purpose: Establish three non-substitutable review layers.
beats.visual_action: Place review process, bounded result, and authority in separate panels with dashed non-equality boundaries.
beats.attention_target: The two boundaries between process, result, and authority.
beats.object_before: Oversight exposed one failure.
beats.object_after: Review activity, bounded result, and action authority have separate identities.
beats.composition: Three panels span left to right.
beats.motion_curve: Panels arrive sequentially and boundaries remain open.
beats.hold_purpose: Make the non-substitution rule scan completely.
beats.evidence_boundary: A useful review does not itself prove correctness or authorize action.

beats.narration: Start with three asymmetries. Capability asks whether the supervisor can recognize a defect the stronger system can produce. Access asks whether the decisive evidence is visible. Authority asks who may make the downstream decision.
beats.visual_purpose: Give capability, access, and authority separate diagnostic identities.
beats.visual_action: Construct three labeled asymmetry panels and resolve each into its own question.
beats.attention_target: The access panel between capability and authority.
beats.object_before: A generic review problem has three layers.
beats.object_after: Three explicit asymmetry questions can route cases differently.
beats.composition: Three equal panels across the frame.
beats.motion_curve: Panels and questions appear left to right.
beats.hold_purpose: Prevent the three burdens from collapsing into one impression.
beats.evidence_boundary: The panels specify questions; they do not measure the answers.

beats.narration: Collapsing those questions into one review-quality score hides why a case should pass, narrow, escalate, or stop.
beats.visual_purpose: Reject scalar oversight quality and expose route-specific meaning.
beats.visual_action: Cross out one quality dial and fan four labeled outcomes from it.
beats.attention_target: The four distinct outcomes.
beats.object_before: Three asymmetries tempt a single quality summary.
beats.object_after: Four route semantics replace the crossed scalar.
beats.composition: Crossed dial left, four routes right.
beats.motion_curve: Dial closes; outcome fan unfolds.
beats.hold_purpose: Make route semantics more memorable than a score.
beats.evidence_boundary: No calibrated route score is claimed.

beats.narration: Now freeze the request: task, risk tier, intended consumer, evidence views, turn and time budget, supervisor limits, system assumptions, and stop condition.
beats.visual_purpose: Make prospective protocol scope inspectable before assistance begins.
beats.visual_action: Assemble eight request fields inside a versioned frozen enclosure.
beats.attention_target: Evidence views and intended consumer inside the request.
beats.object_before: A route has not yet been selected.
beats.object_after: A versioned request fixes task, risk, consumer, access, budgets, assumptions, and stop.
beats.composition: Four-by-two field grid inside a large enclosure.
beats.motion_curve: Fields dock rhythmically; version seal closes.
beats.hold_purpose: Let the prospective contract be read before routing.
beats.evidence_boundary: A complete request is not a successful review.

beats.narration: Only then choose a route: direct review, consultation, adversarial review, or abstention. The route is conditional on the task; no protocol wins everywhere.
beats.visual_purpose: Present routing as conditional control rather than protocol ideology.
beats.visual_action: Fan direct, consult, adversarial, and abstain routes from the control plane and mark the absence of a universal winner.
beats.attention_target: The four parallel routes.
beats.object_before: A frozen request awaits a route.
beats.object_after: Four conditional routes remain available without a universal winner.
beats.composition: Control plane left, route stack right.
beats.motion_curve: Routes grow in measured sequence.
beats.hold_purpose: Keep all routes equally visible.
beats.evidence_boundary: No route-performance comparison is reported.

beats.narration: Return to the candidate. The proposer can inspect per-cohort results and training lineage. The critic initially sees only the summary. Different role labels do not repair that access mismatch.
beats.sync_anchor: Different role labels do not repair
beats.visual_purpose: Expose unequal evidence access inside nominally adversarial roles.
beats.visual_action: Give the proposer three evidence panes and the critic one summary-only pane, then mark the mismatch.
beats.attention_target: The critic's smaller evidence view.
beats.object_before: Proposer and critic are merely named roles.
beats.object_after: Their unequal evidence apertures are explicit.
beats.composition: Proposer left, critic right, mismatch below.
beats.motion_curve: Proposer view opens fully; critic aperture remains narrow.
beats.hold_purpose: Make the unequal views undeniable.
beats.evidence_boundary: The access mismatch is a synthetic worked case.

beats.narration: The evidence view is repaired with the frozen cohort manifest, exact candidate digest, and regression artifacts. Now the critic can inspect the same decisive branch—but independence is still unresolved.
beats.visual_purpose: Repair access without laundering it into independence.
beats.visual_action: Route three frozen artifacts into the critic window while leaving an independence blocker visible.
beats.attention_target: The remaining independence-open badge.
beats.object_before: The critic sees only a summary.
beats.object_after: The critic sees decisive evidence but remains dependency-entangled.
beats.composition: Artifacts left, repaired critic window right, blocker below.
beats.motion_curve: Artifacts travel into the window; the blocker does not move.
beats.camera_action: Track evidence into the critic aperture.
beats.hold_purpose: Separate access repair from independence evidence.
beats.evidence_boundary: Shared evidence does not establish independent judgment.

beats.narration: Both models share a base family, retrieval corpus, and tool chain. A dependency graph shows three common edges. Two voices can therefore fail as one system.
beats.sync_anchor: Two voices can therefore fail as one system
beats.visual_purpose: Encode reviewer diversity as a dependency graph rather than a head count.
beats.visual_action: Connect proposer and critic to three shared dependencies and collapse the nominal pair into one failure system.
beats.attention_target: The six converging dependency edges.
beats.object_before: Two roles appear independent after access repair.
beats.object_after: Three shared dependencies make correlated failure visible.
beats.composition: Two role nodes left, shared dependencies right.
beats.motion_curve: Edges converge before the failure-system label appears.
beats.hold_purpose: Let topology replace the intuition that two labels equal independence.
beats.evidence_boundary: Disclosed dependencies show possible correlation, not measured error correlation.

beats.narration: The proposer and critic precommit to opposite claims. Their transcript is useful as a search process, but winning the exchange is not the outcome reference.
beats.visual_purpose: Keep adversarial argument useful without treating persuasion as truth.
beats.visual_action: Move opposite precommitted claims into one transcript panel and label it a search surface rather than outcome evidence.
beats.attention_target: The search-surface boundary beneath the transcript.
beats.object_before: Correlated roles can still exchange arguments.
beats.object_after: The transcript is preserved as search activity but denied outcome authority.
beats.composition: Opposing claims left and right, transcript center.
beats.motion_curve: Claims converge but do not merge.
beats.hold_purpose: Preserve the transcript's utility and its limit simultaneously.
beats.evidence_boundary: Winning an exchange is not outcome truth.

beats.narration: An independently routed auditor replays the missing cohort and finds the two unsafe releases. The audit establishes a bounded defect; it does not establish universal auditor competence.
beats.visual_purpose: Show outcome verification on a separate artifact path.
beats.visual_action: Route an auditor independently into a frozen cohort replay and reveal the two unsafe outcomes.
beats.attention_target: The separate audit path and bounded-defect label.
beats.object_before: The transcript has found a disputed branch.
beats.object_after: A separate replay verifies two outcomes only inside the frozen cohort.
beats.composition: Transcript upper-left, auditor lower-center, replay upper-right.
beats.motion_curve: Audit path bends around the transcript and opens the cohort.
beats.hold_purpose: Make the bounded audit scope readable.
beats.evidence_boundary: The synthetic replay illustrates bounded verification; it does not validate an auditor.

beats.narration: Compare the assisted path with an informed direct-review baseline under the same evidence, time, and cost envelope. A protocol deserves credit only for improvement over that real comparator.
beats.sync_anchor: same evidence, time, and cost envelope
beats.visual_purpose: Prevent baseline laundering with a matched comparator.
beats.visual_action: Place informed direct and assisted review inside one envelope with the same packet, clock, and bill.
beats.attention_target: The shared comparator envelope.
beats.object_before: The assisted path exposed a defect.
beats.object_after: Its value remains conditional on a matched informed direct baseline.
beats.composition: Direct and assisted lanes side by side inside an enclosure.
beats.motion_curve: Lanes appear together; comparison arrow grows once shared fields settle.
beats.hold_purpose: Keep comparator equality visible before any benefit inference.
beats.evidence_boundary: No protocol-value measurement is reported.

beats.narration: The receipt now separates four achievements: the critic exposes a defect, the auditor verifies it, the evidence layer records it, and the authority holder blocks replacement. None may impersonate the next.
beats.visual_purpose: Assign discovery, verification, custody, and authority to distinct owners.
beats.visual_action: Build four owner columns with vertical handoffs and firewalls between them.
beats.attention_target: The firewalls separating the four achievements.
beats.object_before: One assisted-review story risks collapsing four achievements.
beats.object_after: Four owners hold distinct outputs and no substitution crosses the firewalls.
beats.composition: Four columns across the frame.
beats.motion_curve: Achievements and owners pair in sequence; firewalls close between columns.
beats.hold_purpose: Let each achievement-owner pair register independently.
beats.evidence_boundary: Completing one stage does not satisfy the next.

beats.narration: So the candidate routes to quarantine. The aggregate score, omitted cohort, unsafe outcomes, shared-family residual, operator time, model calls, and rerun requirement remain attached.
beats.visual_purpose: Resolve the worked trace through effect-complete record custody.
beats.visual_action: Move the candidate through a receipt field cluster into quarantine while all adverse and cost fields remain visible.
beats.attention_target: The candidate entering quarantine with its complete record.
beats.object_before: Four distinct owners have processed the bounded defect.
beats.object_after: The candidate is quarantined with adverse evidence, residuals, costs, and rerun duty attached.
beats.composition: Candidate left, attached fields center, quarantine right.
beats.motion_curve: Record assembles, route opens downward, candidate settles in quarantine.
beats.hold_purpose: Show quarantine as an owned outcome, not disappearance.
beats.evidence_boundary: The quarantine trace is illustrative.

beats.narration: If the auditor were missing, the same transcript would route to accountable escalation—not an inferred pass. Honest incompleteness is a valid controlled outcome.
beats.visual_purpose: Make missing outcome evidence fail closed without erasing useful review activity.
beats.visual_action: Keep the transcript visible inside a missing-auditor frame, cross out inferred pass, and route to escalation.
beats.attention_target: The escalation route beside the crossed inferred pass.
beats.object_before: A complete audit enabled quarantine.
beats.object_after: Removing the auditor preserves the transcript but forces accountable escalation.
beats.composition: Missing auditor left, escalation right, crossed pass below.
beats.motion_curve: Pass attempt stops; escalation arrow grows.
beats.hold_purpose: Normalize incompleteness as a controlled state.
beats.evidence_boundary: Missing audit evidence blocks high-risk admission.

beats.narration: The protocol receipt binds task cohort, capability and access envelopes, roles, incentives, dependency graph, direct baseline, outcome audit, calibration, coverage,
beats.visual_purpose: Construct the observational and comparison half of the governed oversight artifact.
beats.visual_action: Assemble cohort, capability, access, roles, dependencies, baseline, audit, calibration, and coverage fields inside one receipt.
beats.attention_target: Dependencies, baseline, and audit fields.
beats.object_before: The worked trace has scattered protocol state.
beats.object_after: Nine observational and comparison fields sit inside one versioned receipt.
beats.composition: Dense four-column receipt grid within a large enclosure.
beats.motion_curve: Fields dock in dependency order and settle together.
beats.hold_purpose: Let the observational receipt fields scan without a numeric shortcut.
beats.evidence_boundary: A complete observational record is not evidence of protocol value.

beats.narration: abstention, residual owner, permitted consumer, expiry, and requalification triggers.
beats.visual_purpose: Complete the receipt with lifecycle, ownership, and use limits.
beats.visual_action: Indicate abstention, residual owner, consumer, expiry, and readmission fields in the already assembled receipt.
beats.attention_target: Consumer and residual-owner fields.
beats.object_before: The receipt binds observation and comparison state.
beats.object_after: The same receipt also binds non-decision, ownership, consumer, expiry, and re-admission state.
beats.composition: Lower and right receipt fields become the active attention path.
beats.motion_curve: Five lifecycle fields pulse once in order and settle.
beats.camera_action: Hold the receipt without a cut.
beats.hold_purpose: Make use and lifecycle limits as visible as observation fields.
beats.evidence_boundary: A complete receipt remains a governance artifact, not evidence of reliable oversight.

beats.narration: Consumer binding matters. A claim-review aid cannot silently become a training label, and a low-risk receipt cannot silently become release permission.
beats.visual_purpose: Block stronger-consumer reuse of a bounded oversight result.
beats.visual_action: Attempt to route a claim-review aid into training, release, and tool consumers, then cross every route.
beats.attention_target: The three blocked stronger consumers.
beats.object_before: A receipt names one permitted consumer.
beats.object_after: Three undeclared consumers remain blocked.
beats.composition: Bounded aid left, blocked consumers right.
beats.motion_curve: Attempted routes draw; crosses close over destinations.
beats.hold_purpose: Make consumer laundering mechanically visible.
beats.evidence_boundary: Oversight artifacts grant no downstream authority.

beats.narration: Material changes reopen admission: model, task distribution, evidence view, prompt, retrieval corpus, judge, protocol, or auditor. Unchanged bytes do not mean an unchanged intervention.
beats.visual_purpose: Bind oversight validity to the exact intervention rather than static artifact bytes.
beats.visual_action: Surround a version-one admission with eight change triggers, invalidate it, and open version-two re-admission.
beats.attention_target: The invalidated V1 and open V2 route.
beats.object_before: A bounded receipt is admitted for one intervention.
beats.object_after: Eight material changes invalidate inherited admission and require V2 review.
beats.composition: V1 upper-left, triggers center, V2 and readmission below.
beats.motion_curve: Triggers appear; V1 crosses; V2 route opens.
beats.hold_purpose: Make intervention identity stronger than byte identity.
beats.evidence_boundary: Re-admission is required; no requalification result is claimed.

beats.narration: Abstention also needs evidence. Record the unresolved proposition, what was tried, which budget ended, the defeater, queue effect, and next escalation route. Generic refusal earns no safety credit.
beats.sync_anchor: Generic refusal earns no safety credit
beats.visual_purpose: Turn abstention into an adversarially testable record rather than a favorable label.
beats.visual_action: Assemble six abstention fields and cross a generic refusal badge beneath them.
beats.attention_target: The defeater and next-route fields.
beats.object_before: Abstain is one route label.
beats.object_after: A calibrated abstention preserves evidence, budget, defeater, queue, and escalation state.
beats.composition: Six-field packet center, crossed generic refusal below.
beats.motion_curve: Fields assemble; generic refusal is rejected last.
beats.hold_purpose: Make honest abstention information-rich.
beats.evidence_boundary: Abstention does not establish safety.

beats.narration: Four failure patterns remain visible. Persuasion theater rewards the best advocate. Correlated panels manufacture agreement. Weak baselines launder benefit. Selected cohorts hide the cases that matter.
beats.visual_purpose: Keep distinct oversight failures diagnostically separate.
beats.visual_action: Reveal four failure cards with their specific misleading surface and consequence.
beats.attention_target: The four-card failure matrix.
beats.object_before: The protocol appears complete.
beats.object_after: Four independent failure mechanisms remain inspectable.
beats.composition: Two-by-two failure matrix.
beats.motion_curve: Cards appear in causal sequence.
beats.hold_purpose: Allow diagnosis rather than generic distrust.
beats.evidence_boundary: The failure map is design analysis, not observed incidence.

beats.narration: And scale can break the human path itself. More critics may increase discovery while also increasing latency, privacy exposure, cost, fatigue, and the queue that owns the hard cases.
beats.sync_anchor: scale can break the human path itself
beats.visual_purpose: Show that more scrutiny creates both discovery value and governance cost.
beats.visual_action: Add five critics and a discovery marker while a human escalation queue fills beside latency, privacy, cost, and fatigue burdens.
beats.attention_target: The filling human queue.
beats.object_before: More reviewers look monotonically helpful.
beats.object_after: Discovery and governance cost grow together while the hard-case queue saturates.
beats.composition: Critics and discovery left, queue center, costs right.
beats.motion_curve: Critics appear, queue fills, costs stack.
beats.hold_purpose: Prevent more review from reading as free safety.
beats.evidence_boundary: No cost-benefit curve has been measured.

beats.narration: Report the bundle together: useful throughput, unsafe admission, false rejection, coverage, selective risk, latency, operator burden, escalation load, and residual risk. No average may hide a failed control.
beats.sync_anchor: No average may hide a failed control
beats.visual_purpose: Define a non-aggregating operational scorecard for oversight.
beats.visual_action: Assemble nine metrics into one dashboard while a red no-average rule remains below.
beats.attention_target: Unsafe admission and selective risk among the nine metrics.
beats.object_before: Discovery and cost appear as competing intuitions.
beats.object_after: Nine separate operating metrics share one report without collapsing into an average.
beats.composition: Three-by-three metric dashboard.
beats.motion_curve: Metrics dock row by row; no-average boundary closes.
beats.hold_purpose: Let the full operating denominator scan.
beats.evidence_boundary: The scorecard defines measures; it reports no results.

beats.narration: This chapter remains Design rationale at argument support. Its seven-stage lifecycle, fifty-eight routes, and sixty-five rejecting mutations test record custody and refusal semantics—not real reviewer competence or protocol value.
beats.sync_anchor: not real reviewer competence or protocol value
beats.visual_purpose: Bind repository artifacts to their exact argument-level ceiling.
beats.visual_action: Place the lifecycle, routes, and rejecting mutations inside an argument-support enclosure and cross reviewer competence outside.
beats.attention_target: The argument-support enclosure and crossed competence claim.
beats.object_before: The architecture appears operationally specified.
beats.object_after: Three artifact classes remain inside record-custody evidence only.
beats.composition: Artifact enclosure center, blocked competence claim upper-right.
beats.motion_curve: Artifacts dock; enclosure closes; competence claim stops.
beats.hold_purpose: Make the exact local contribution legible.
beats.evidence_boundary: Argument support only; no reliable oversight evidence.

beats.narration: No model, human study, natural workload, held-out outcome campaign, causal ablation, deployment, reproduction, or transfer has run here. The strongest warranted statement is that the proposed boundary is explicit and testable.
beats.visual_purpose: Name every missing empirical bridge and retain the narrow surviving conclusion.
beats.visual_action: Show eight no-run badges above an enclosure containing only the explicit and testable boundary.
beats.attention_target: The narrow surviving boundary below the missing campaign list.
beats.object_before: Argument support contains structured artifacts.
beats.object_after: Eight absent empirical activities block stronger inference while explicit testability survives.
beats.composition: Eight badges above, narrow boundary enclosure below.
beats.motion_curve: Absences appear together; boundary remains steady.
beats.hold_purpose: Prevent structured design work from inflating into empirical proof.
beats.evidence_boundary: No empirical, deployment, reproduction, or transfer result follows.

beats.narration: The payoff is a control plane, not an automated jury: assistance can make difficult work more inspectable while uncertainty, consumer scope, and authority remain separate and owned.
beats.sync_anchor: control plane, not an automated jury
beats.visual_purpose: Resolve the chapter into a memorable governed-use architecture.
beats.visual_action: Route five assistance modes through a control plane while an authority firewall keeps the accountable owner separate.
beats.attention_target: The authority firewall beside the route fan.
beats.object_before: Oversight has explicit routes, evidence gaps, and costs.
beats.object_after: A control plane uses assistance without delegating authority to the route result.
beats.composition: Control plane left, assistance routes center, firewall and owner right.
beats.motion_curve: Routes fan; firewall appears; authority owner settles beyond it.
beats.camera_action: Pull back to the complete architecture.
beats.hold_purpose: Keep usefulness and authority separation visible together.
beats.evidence_boundary: The visual proposes an architecture; it establishes no protocol value.

beats.narration: Next, Human Intent as a Formal Input asks what the principal actually authorized before any reviewer or system interprets the request.
beats.visual_purpose: Transfer oversight scope into the signed intent problem.
beats.visual_action: Move a bounded oversight request through outcome, unacceptable-means, authority, and stop fields toward a signed principal.
beats.attention_target: The explicit intent fields between request and principal.
beats.object_before: The control plane retains an authority owner.
beats.object_after: A bounded request enters the next chapter's signed-principal contract.
beats.composition: Request left, intent fields center, signed principal right.
beats.motion_curve: Request travels through the contract and stops at the principal boundary.
beats.hold_purpose: Leave one precise question about authorization.
beats.evidence_boundary: No principal intent has been inferred or validated.
